decisions.reason: The firm has already invested in a certified specialist naval line and, consistent with escalation of commitment, management is likely to keep attributing any weak traction to long naval procurement and approval cycles rather than withdraw now.

Although this desk lamp is less central to the firm's announced strategic direction, its dedicated launch, existing design investment and the tendency to justify recent introductions still make management more likely to continue than to exit.

As a general interior luminaire close to the firm's core building-lighting business, this product benefits from strong strategic fit and prior public commitment, so management would be reluctant to reverse course after only a short time on the market.

Because this pendant luminaire was presented as a flagship for the firm's future direction, the high visibility of the commitment and its centrality to sustainable, intelligent lighting make withdrawal very unlikely.

After already pruning one marine searchlight variant, management is likely to persist with the remaining marine line to defend sunk engineering effort and explain results through slow specialist order timing rather than abandon the niche altogether.
